findings.title: self-heal-pipeline.md failure table says 'Bump version' but the field is schema_version
findings.detail: docs/self-heal-pipeline.md failure-modes table (fingerprint-drift row) instructs operators to 'Bump `version` in `closed.json`', but the canonical schema at lines 39/92 names the field `schema_version`. This mismatch was created when the field was renamed (documented at line 65), but the failure table was not updated.
findings.fix_sketch: Change 'Bump `version` in `closed.json`' to 'Bump `schema_version` in `closed.json`' in the failure-modes table.

findings.title: ADR headings use 3-digit format (ADR-001) but inline references use 4-digit (ADR-0001)
findings.detail: ifleet-integration-adrs.md headings are formatted 'ADR-001', 'ADR-002', 'ADR-003' (3 digits) while inline cross-references use 'ADR-0001' and 'ADR-0002' (4 digits). This inconsistency makes automated tooling or grep-based cross-referencing unreliable.
findings.fix_sketch: Normalise to 3-digit format throughout: change ADR-0001 → ADR-001, ADR-0002 → ADR-002 in inline references.

findings.title: ADR-002 line 91 self-references 'ADR-0002' for a fallback pattern that appears to originate in ADR-001
findings.detail: docs/ifleet-integration-adrs.md line 91, within the body of ADR-002, reads 'matches the Docker-unreachable fallback in ADR-0002'. Referencing the document you're currently writing is a self-reference that confuses readers. Based on context (ADR-001 covers Codex/Docker wiring), the intended reference is likely ADR-001.
findings.fix_sketch: Change 'ADR-0002' to 'ADR-001' on that line, or rephrase to 'the same unavailability-banner pattern defined earlier in this ADR'.
